test_title: PYST 5: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language. 'YJM' is coded as '26 - 11 - 14' and 'SOP' is coded as '20-16-17'. What is the code for 'BTX' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'YJM' is coded as '26 - 11 - 14'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/907eba7af6f0aebdbbe9c12f246489526113564413a67e004387228bd8d799d6.png] 

And, 

 
• 'SOP' is coded as '20-16-17'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/392dff59864311c04e56b5c6f44967885f92e251124433bf4521f71ef44cf1f9.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'BTX' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/165e0f02a8de1253e6f1aa97976cf67832928c58ae79eaab8430d450ae06b57c.png] 

Hence, "**3 - 21 - 25**" is the correct answer.
